lines.text: In the ninth year the word of the LORD told Ezekiel to write down the date the king of Nineveh besieged Jerusalem.
God told Ezekiel to speak a parable to the rebellious house about a pot filled with choice meat and bones.
God said the city poured out her blood on the bare rock, so He placed it there to take vengeance.
God said to pile on the logs and set the empty pot on the coals until its copper glows, and the bones be buried.
God said He tried to cleanse them but they were not purified, and He will judge them according to their ways and deeds.
